#schema: # The issueless population is unconditional -- Phase 4 runs it after the jury
# resolves, and the activate path re-runs it before the transition -- so
# `roadmap populate --no-issues` is always-required. The flag is named because
# the subcommand's default flipped once while its surface stayed identical; no
# path in this skill may depend on that default.
# Issue-creating mode is reached only by an explicit post-approval invocation.
# It is where the milestone and mapping flags appear, and it is the only path
# that reaches GitHub: `--no-issues` makes no gh call of any kind, so gh is
# declared for that mode and not always.
